description: Report an abusive IP address to AbuseIPDB. Requires category IDs (e.g., "18,22" for DDoS + SSH brute force). Returns the updated abuse confidence score.

examples.comment: SSH brute force attack from this IP

categories.description: Comma-separated category IDs (e.g., "18,22"). Common: 3=Fraud, 4=DDoS, 14=Port Scan, 18=Brute Force, 22=SSH, 23=Telnet

comment.description: Description of the abuse (e.g., "SSH brute force attack from this IP")

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to report (e.g., "118.25.6.39")

name: report_ip

abuse_confidence_score.description: Updated abuse confidence score after report

reported.description: Confirmation that the IP was reported successfully

title: Report Ip
